title: RLQGR3: adaptive exact Toom arithmetic in linear quantum space

claims.statement: For RLQGR3 in proof.md, for every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, let n=ceil(log2 N), m=2048(n+10), J=n+4, H=n+ceil(log2(m(J+1)+2))+20 and M=2^24 H. Use the complete label-extraction, record-scoring and exact Grover configuration specified there, including its finite n=1 branch. Unconditional entire-secret recovery has probability greater than 2/3. On every execution branch this same algorithm has total sequential work T=O(2^(n/2+64 sqrt(log2 n)) n^2 (log2 n)^2) for n>=2, with fixed absolute cost for n=1, jointly with all other resource bounds and floor(Q/10) malformed-copy tolerance under the explicit error model below, including clean ideal input. All constants are absolute. The supported envelope B(n)=2^(n/2+64 sqrt(log2 n)) n^2 (log2 n)^2 for n>=2 has exact growth index 1. Complete uniform circuits, controller, addressing, preprocessing, precision and acquisition accounting are proved in proof.md.

For the same RLQGR3 algorithm/configuration in proof.md, for every N>=2 and every s, n=ceil(log2 N) and actual acquired count Q=2048(n+10), the guaranteed malformed-copy threshold is tau(n,Q)=floor(Q/10), with ordinary integer floor. Under the fixed-position corruption model in its structured error_model, every allowed joint state with at most this many malformed positions retains unconditional full-secret success greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds jointly on every branch. Clean independent ideal input is included. No larger-tolerance impossibility or per-copy corruption probability is asserted.

structured.error_model: Among Q acquired source copies, at most tau(n,Q) positions fixed before the algorithm private randomness may contain an arbitrary joint state on their declared source registers. Every other copy is an independent ideal coset state for the same fixed secret s; their product state is independent of the malformed subsystem. The adversary may know N,s and the algorithm but cannot alter the controller or registers after delivery. Malformed copies may be mutually entangled. The algorithm is not told the malformed positions.
